title: Karto edge provenance JSONL record
canonical_edge_identity: Directed [source_state_id, target_state_id] pair at first graph-edge creation; this is an observer identity, not an official Karto numeric edge ID.

compatibility.target_backend_measurement: Deprecated compatibility field. For v7 historical outputs it means at least one exact target-attributable full-graph constraint. New analyses use target_pose_graph_constraint and target_constraint_realized.
compatibility.target_constraint: Legacy explicit TryCloseLoop-plus-edge outcome. It is not renamed or silently widened.
